title: UX system delivery programmes
note: An ordered list, which the owner approves one programme at a time. Each slice fits one agent in one worktree (AGENTS.md workflow). 'journeys' holds job ids from journeys.json. Page ids come from map/all.json; the 'new' ids are defined in target-ia.md §1.4. Slice effort: S is at most 1 agent-day, M is 2-3 and L is about a week (split an L before starting where possible). A programme's effortTotal counts S as 1, M as 2.5 and L as 5 agent-days; its size is S up to 3 days, M up to 10, L up to 20 and XL beyond. Proof follows the audit-trail rule: a docs/qa/<feature>-<date>/README.md record with emulator or phone evidence.

programmes.title: Critical quick fixes
programmes.oneLine: Eight small fixes: stop leaking secrets, never lose data, no dead ends, and every team door opens one page.
why: security-privacy: MCP bearer tokens in clear is the map's critical security finding (mcp_setup_screen.dart:586-599)
